subject.why: The illustration clearly depicts a pastel pink single-storey suburban house with the required white picket fence, front lawn, and the round porthole window above the front door.

category.why: It follows Category 4 accurately: low camera angle making the house look heroic, a clean ground strip at the bottom, volumetric cumulus clouds along the horizon, and a smooth saturated blue sky gradient with no clutter.

clean.why: There is no text, UI, watermarks, frames, borders, or characters.

framing.why: The house is well-centered with generous margins at the top and sides, grounding neatly at the bottom edge without feeling cramped.

colour.why: Vibrant and saturated palette with warm pinks, rich greens, and bright blues that clearly separate the house from the background.

detail.why: The details are stylized and chunky with no noisy micro-textures, grooves, or unnecessary props.

style.why: The rendering features smooth, rounded volumes, a clean satin sheen, and no outlines, perfectly matching the established reference style.
